name: automated-client-acquisition
description: Run cold email, LinkedIn outreach and lead generation from your AI assistant. Define your ICP, build lead lists, launch campaigns, check deliverability, triage replies and create content in your ACA workspace. One sign-in, no API keys. Email sequences carry an unsubscribe link by default, and the skills treat every request to stop as final.

interface.longDescription: ACA (Automated Client Acquisition) runs B2B outbound in one workspace: contacts and lead lists, LinkedIn and email campaigns, a unified inbox and content. This plugin connects your assistant to your ACA workspace with one OAuth sign-in and adds 31 skills: kickoff and ICP onboarding, finding and scoring leads, campaign strategy and copy, deliverability audits and incident response, reply scoring, pipeline status, content weeks and weekly optimisation. Campaigns and lead magnets are created as inactive drafts that you review and activate in ACA.
defaultPrompt: Run ACA kickoff for my workspace
Find leads that match my ICP
